source: Ported from pi's packages/ai/scripts/generate-models.ts at commit 2b0a123. Where a standard cost is given, it is pinned from https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (see generate-models.ts:428-431, the comment above OPENAI_STANDARD_COSTS).

excludedIds._comment: generate-models.ts:356, MODELS_DEV_OPENAI_UNSUPPORTED_MODEL_IDS. models.dev lists this alias, but it is not accepted by OpenAI APIs (generate-models.ts:1794).

shortContextCappedIds._comment: generate-models.ts:380-388, OPENAI_SHORT_CONTEXT_CAPPED_MODEL_IDS. Applied at generate-models.ts:2807-2810: keeps direct OpenAI requests in the short-context pricing tier by default, so contextWindow is capped to the long-context threshold and maxTokens to 128000.

longContextPricingIds._comment: generate-models.ts:390-401, OPENAI_LONG_CONTEXT_PRICING_MODEL_IDS. Applied at generate-models.ts:2811-2814: cost = withOpenAiLongContextPricing(OPENAI_STANDARD_COSTS[id] ?? modelsDevCost) -- note this REPLACES the base rate with the standard cost when one is pinned, not just the tier. withOpenAiLongContextPricing (generate-models.ts:413-425) then adds one tier, active above longContextInputThreshold input tokens: input x2, output x1.5, cacheRead x2, cacheWrite x2, each rounded to 6 decimal places (roundCost, generate-models.ts:1228-1230).

standardCosts._comment: generate-models.ts:428-438, OPENAI_STANDARD_COSTS. Keeps current OpenAI prices authoritative over models.dev until it catches up; USD per million tokens. Only ever consulted from within longContextPricingIds (every key here is also in longContextPricingIds.ids); ids in longContextPricingIds but absent here (gpt-5.4, gpt-5.4-pro, gpt-5.5, gpt-5.5-pro) keep the models.dev base rate instead.

maxOutputFixes._comment: generate-models.ts:2820-2824. models.dev reports gpt-5-pro output as 272000, a duplicate of the input sub-limit; the actual max output is 128000.

serviceTierMultipliers._comment: Not part of the vendored model table: pi applies these to a computed UsageCost, per request, based on the OpenAI Responses `service_tier` the response used (getServiceTierCostMultiplier / applyServiceTierPricing, packages/ai/src/api/openai-responses.ts:367-393). tau_ai::cost exposes this as a separate ServiceTier argument to `cost()`, since pi's own Usage type carries no service-tier field either (packages/ai/src/types.ts:420-439).
